WITH filtered_telescopes AS (
  SELECT t.*, o.weathprofile
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
),
profile_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    weathprofile,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM filtered_telescopes
  GROUP BY weathprofile
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as overall_mean
  FROM profile_stats
)
SELECT 
  p.weathprofile,
  p.avg_bandwidth,
  p.telescope_count,
  p.avg_bandwidth - os.overall_mean as distance_from_mean
FROM profile_stats p
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE os.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.weathprofile
